reviewed_changes: Settings gains General, Connections and System tabs in a left rail; General holds appearance and playback, Connections holds Spotify, Discord and the new opt-in Last.fm section, System holds updates and cache

The sidebar gains Home at the top and loses Favorites, so all 156 full-window references change; Settings also gets the wider (11 rem) tab rail, a Normalize volume switch (off by default) and the version 0.8.21; the other 20 references (sign-in screens) are pixel-identical to 0.8.19

Renamed to Sonder with a ripple mark on a dark grey tile: the sidebar brand, its logo and the fixture artist text change in every full-window reference, and Settings shows version 0.8.22 and Sonder wording; the 20 sign-in references only change where they name the app

The mascot is removed: the Settings Mascot row and the four open-selector references are gone, the Playback card now holds Autoplay and Normalize volume, and the sidebar logo is the new near-black tile with a thin chrome rim; Settings shows version 0.8.23

Track lists lose the favorites star column and its header icon; Home gains Last 4 weeks / Last 6 months / All time buttons and a rank under each artist (replacing the word Artist); Settings shows version 0.8.24

UI zoom is now a seven-step Dense to Spacious scale (70-130%) in Settings, with 70% and 130% replacing the old 75% and 125% zoom scenes; Settings gains a Streaming quality row (Very high by default); Home gains a New from artists section below the top artists; the sidebar mark is redrawn with a firmer chrome rim; Settings shows version 0.8.25

Eight new references: Premium-required (shown to free Spotify accounts instead of the app closing), Home with top artists and tracks, and Home asking for the new top-items permission; each in dark/light and regular/compact
The Cache text now mentions the bounded on-disk artwork cache (48 MiB); Clear cache empties memory and disk
Last.fm scrobbling is event-driven with one idle worker thread, one exact timer and a bounded retry queue; its secret and session key stay in the system keychain
Liking or unliking keeps the library fingerprint current so refreshes stay two-request probes; the audio writer wakes every 10 ms instead of 2 ms and the backend runtime uses two worker threads

The track right-click menu gains a Copy Spotify link row above Open track in Spotify; Settings shows version 0.8.26; Home also gains a Coming soon row and a NEW badge on fresh releases, which only appear with live data, so no reference shows them
Settings shows version 0.8.27; Home now opens first and shows placeholder cards while its release rows load, which no reference captures because the scenes answer every request
